title: Adopt EKODI 모두의 AI 프로젝트 as the canonical public AI surface
approvalRef: Owner confirmation in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-09-14 directing EKODI collaboration to deploy and operate the AI Commons through all subordinate service sites.
approvalMechanism: constitution-approved label on PR #1669 after explicit owner confirmation
reason: Expose the reusable AI Commons at the canonical apex path while keeping provider, runtime and capability topology internal. User-facing subordinate sites inherit a shared AI entry and the Super Administrator retains the final publish/hold/reject gate.

diff.summary: Register ai-commons as a public-user exception, reserve /ai as a canonical surface and replace the retired ai.ekodi.kr user gateway with https://ekodi.kr/ai.

risks: A public AI entry could accidentally expose internal provider or capability topology if projection boundaries regress.
Cross-site request aggregation could reveal tenant-private requester data if public projections are widened.
Automatic AI build progression could bypass human authority if the staged/public-review gate is weakened.
rollback: Revert the AI Commons public-surface policy and related runtime/config changes through the guarded pipeline. Preserve request data and audit history; do not recreate ai.ekodi.kr as a public compatibility route without a separate approved amendment.
evidence: 36 user services inherit the shared AI entry through the User UI Shell
AI detailed lifecycle progresses automatically but public release requires Super Administrator decision
staging validates the AI Commons project page and authenticated request boundary
